summary: SSE vector helper (stdcall): computes a weighted vector sum v = a2[0].x * a3[0] + a2[1].x * a3[1] where the two scalar weights are broadcast from the x-lanes of the a2 dwords, stores the low 2 floats of the result to a1, and returns a1. Straightforward blend/interpolation helper with no branches, calls, or globals.

operations.description: Broadcast scalar weights from the x-lane of a2[0] (mask 0) and a2[1].x (mask 0).
Weighted sum v = a2[0].x * a3[0] + a2[1].x * a3[1]; each weight scales its corresponding vector before the vectors are added.
Store the low 2 floats (x,y) of the weighted sum into a1.
Return a1 as the result pointer.

clean_pseudocode: // a2 dwords provide scalar weights from their x-lanes; a3 is a vector array
v = a2[0].x * a3[0] + a2[1].x * a3[1];  // weighted vector sum
unresolved: Whether the two vectors a3[0]/a3[1] are basis/edge vectors or endpoints of a segment depends on the caller.
Only the low 2 floats are written to a1; the z/w lanes are discarded, so the caller's vector dimension is unknown.
